svg.title: Sperm usually came back after supervised testosterone. Years of steroid use is a different story.
svg.desc: Top: in 30 male-contraception studies of 1,549 healthy men, the share whose sperm count recovered to 20 million per mL after stopping was 67% within 6 months, 90% within 12, 96% within 16 and 100% within 24 months. Bottom: in a Danish study, 27% of former steroid users still had testosterone below the normal range about 2.5 years after stopping, vs 0% of 30 non-users.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Supervised testosterone: sperm came back. Years of steroids: not always.
